course.title: Introduction to Physics
course.description: A beginner-friendly introduction to fundamental concepts of physics, including measurement, motion, forces, energy, and gravitation.

content.title: What is Physics?
content.htmlContent:
What is Physics?

Physics is the study of matter, energy, motion, forces, and the fundamental laws that describe the natural world.

data.title: What is Physics?
data.markdown:
## What is Physics?

Physics is the study of matter, energy, motion, forces, and the fundamental laws that describe the natural world.

content.title: Why Learn Physics?
content.htmlContent: Physics helps us understand how objects move, interact, and transfer energy in the world around us.

data.title: Why Learn Physics?
data.markdown: Physics helps us understand how objects move, interact, and transfer energy in the world around us.

modules.title: Units and Measurements
modules.description: Learn how physical quantities are measured and represented using standard units.

content.title: Introduction to Measurement
content.htmlContent: Measurement is the process of comparing a physical quantity with a standard unit.

data.title: Introduction to Measurement
data.markdown: Measurement is the process of comparing a physical quantity with a standard unit.

lessons.title: Physical Quantities and SI Units
lessons.description: Understand physical quantities and the International System of Units.

content.title: Physical Quantities
content.htmlContent: Physical quantities are measurable properties such as length, mass, time, and temperature.

data.title: Physical Quantities
data.markdown: Physical quantities are measurable properties such as length, mass, time, and temperature.

topics.title: SI Base Units
topics.description: Learn the seven fundamental SI base units.

content.title: The Seven SI Base Units
content.htmlContent: The SI system defines seven base units including metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, and candela.

data.title: The Seven SI Base Units
data.markdown: The SI system defines seven base units including metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, and candela.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of length?
questions.explanation: The metre is the SI base unit of length.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of time?
questions.explanation: The second is the SI base unit of time.

assignment.title: Identify Physical Units
assignment.description: Identify the appropriate SI units for different physical quantities.

topics.title: Measurement Errors
topics.description: Understand accuracy, precision, and common measurement errors.

content.title: Accuracy and Precision
content.htmlContent: Accuracy describes how close a measurement is to the true value, while precision describes the consistency of repeated measurements.

data.title: Accuracy and Precision
data.markdown: Accuracy describes how close a measurement is to the true value, while precision describes the consistency of repeated measurements.

questions.question: Which term describes how close a measurement is to the true value?
questions.explanation: Accuracy describes closeness to the true or accepted value.

assignment.title: Measurement Analysis
assignment.description: Analyze a set of measurements and identify their accuracy and precision.

quiz.title: Physical Quantities and SI Units - Lesson Quiz

questions.question: Which of the following is an SI base unit?
questions.explanation: Kilogram is one of the seven SI base units.

questions.question: What does precision describe?
questions.explanation: Precision refers to how consistently repeated measurements agree.

assignment.title: SI Measurement Practice
assignment.description: Solve practical problems involving SI units, measurements, accuracy, and precision.

questions.question: Which is the SI unit of mass?
questions.explanation: The kilogram is the SI base unit of mass.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a standard unit?
questions.explanation: Standard units provide a common reference for measurements.

assignment.title: Units and Measurements Practical Assignment
assignment.description: Complete practical measurement problems and demonstrate your understanding of SI units, accuracy, precision, and measurement errors.

modules.title: Motion in a Straight Line
modules.description: Learn the fundamental concepts of position, displacement, velocity, acceleration, and equations of motion.

content.title: Introduction to Motion
content.htmlContent: Motion describes the change in position of an object with respect to time.

data.title: Introduction to Motion
data.markdown: Motion describes the change in position of an object with respect to time.

lessons.title: Position, Distance and Displacement
lessons.description: Understand how the position and movement of objects are described.

content.title: Distance and Displacement
content.htmlContent: Distance is the total path travelled, while displacement is the change in position from the initial to final point.

data.title: Distance and Displacement
data.markdown: Distance is the total path travelled, while displacement is the change in position from the initial to final point.

topics.title: Distance
topics.description: Learn the concept of distance travelled by an object.

content.title: Understanding Distance
content.htmlContent: Distance is a scalar quantity representing the total length of the path travelled.

data.title: Understanding Distance
data.markdown: Distance is a scalar quantity representing the total length of the path travelled.

questions.question: Distance is a:
questions.explanation: Distance has magnitude but no direction, so it is scalar.

assignment.title: Distance Calculation Exercise
assignment.description: Calculate the distance travelled by objects following different paths.

questions.question: Which quantity includes direction?
questions.explanation: Displacement is a vector quantity and therefore has direction.

assignment.title: Motion Analysis Assignment
assignment.description: Analyze different motion scenarios and calculate distance and displacement.

quiz.title: Motion in a Straight Line - Module Quiz

questions.question: Velocity is defined as:
questions.explanation: Average velocity is displacement divided by the time taken.

assignment.title: Motion and Kinematics Assignment
assignment.description: Solve numerical problems involving distance, displacement, velocity, and acceleration.

quiz.title: Introduction to Physics - Final Course Quiz

questions.question: Which branch of physics deals primarily with motion and forces?
questions.explanation: Mechanics studies motion, forces, and the effects of forces on objects.

questions.question: Which of the following is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Displacement has both magnitude and direction.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of mass?
questions.explanation: Kilogram is the SI base unit of mass.

assignment.title: Introduction to Physics Final Assignment
assignment.description: Complete a comprehensive set of physics problems covering measurement, units, motion, displacement, velocity, and acceleration.
